description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android weather application. It manages UI components, fetches weather data from APIs via network requests, handles permissions, updates the UI with weather info, supports speech input for city search, and checks for app updates.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the weather app, handles UI initialization, data retrieval, user interactions, app updates, and permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, checks for updates, and triggers data fetch.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from voice recognition activity; updates city input field.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar color for Android Lollipop and above.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up UI interaction listeners including search, refresh, and voice input.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Validates and initiates city search or updates.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Fetches last known location and weather data via network.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Resolves city name to coordinates and triggers weather fetch.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches weather info from API and updates UI components.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI with fetched weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates day names to localized language.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows main layout.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Shows loading indicator and hides main content.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and acts accordingly.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks internet connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a new app version is available and prompts update.
